note: A11.4 host narrowing. One Angular client, two Go services that BOTH serve GET /users and GET /users/:id. The client's base URL resolves (A11.2) to http://users-service:8080, and the users dir carries its own docker-compose declaring `users-service` (a per-service compose, so the alias lands on the users RepoId). Before A11.4 each folded endpoint paired with BOTH services (4 HTTP_CALLS); after, only with users (2). Recall alone cannot see this, so the precision gate is the forbid row. It is written on the `/users/{id}` pair because chi (`{id}`) and gin (`:id`) give the two routes DISTINCT qnames; the two `/users` list routes share the qname `route:/users` across repos, so exact-match forbid cannot tell them apart (the Rust unit tests in graph/src/resolvers/http.rs count that case instead). Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: typescript/http_client and go/http_server are already scored elsewhere.
